an4.104:1.8: ti.] 105. 1. Cattāro 'me bhikkhave udakarahadā. Katame cattāro? Uttāno gambhīrobhāso, gambhīro uttānobhāso, uttāno uttānobhāso, gambhīro gambhīrobhāso. Ime kho bhikkhave cattāro udakarahadā. 2. Evam eva kho bhikkhave cattāro 'me udakarahadūpamā puggalā santo saṃvijjamānā lokasmiṃ.
an4.104:2.1: Kathañ ca bhikkhave puggalo uttāno hoti gambhīrobhāso?
an4.104:2.2: Idha bhikkhave ekaccassa puggalassa pāsādikaṃ hoti abhikkantaṃ . . . saṅghātipattacīvaradhāraṇaṃ.
an4.104:2.3: So idaṃ dukkhan ti yathābhūtaṃ nappajānāti . . . ayaṃ dukkhanirodhagāminī paṭipadā ti yathābhūtaṃ nappajānāti.
an4.104:2.4: Evaṃ kho bhikkhave puggalo uttāno hoti gambhīrobhāso,
an4.104:2.5: seyyathāpi so bhikkhave udakarahado uttāno gambhīrobhāso,
an4.104:3.1: Kathañ ca bhikkhave puggalo gambhīro hoti uttānobhāso?
an4.104:3.2: Idha bhikkhave ekaccassa puggalassa na pāsādikaṃ hoti abhikkantaṃ . . . saṅghātipattacīvaradhāraṇaṃ.
an4.104:3.3: So idaṃ dukkhan ti yathābhūtaṃ pajānāti . . . ayaṃ dukkhanirodhagāminī paṭipadā ti yathābhūtaṃ pajānāti.
an4.104:3.4: Evaṃ kho bhikkhave puggalo gambhīro hoti uttānobhāso,
an4.104:3.5: seyyathāpi so bhikkhave udakarahado gambhīro uttānobhāso,
an4.104:4.1: Kathañ ca bhikkhave puggalo uttāno hoti uttānobhāso?
an4.104:4.2: Idha bhikkhave ekaccassa puggalassa na pāsādikaṃ hoti abhikkantaṃ . . . pe . . .
an4.104:4.3: idaṃ dukkhan ti yathābhūtaṃ nappajānāti . . . pe . . . [103. 5] yathābhūtaṃ nappajānāti . . . pe . . .
an4.104:4.4: Evaṃ kho bhikkhave uttāno hoti uttānobhāso,
an4.104:4.5: seyyathāpi so bhikkhave udakarahado uttāno uttānobhāso,
an4.104:5.1: Kathañ ca bhikkhave gambhīro hoti gambhīrobhāso?
an4.104:5.2: Idha bhikkhave ekaccassa puggalassa pāsādikaṃ hoti abhikkantaṃ . . . pe . . .
an4.104:5.3: So idaṃ dukkhan ti yathābhūtaṃ pajānāti . . . pe . . . [103. 6.]
an4.104:5.4: Evaṃ kho bhikkhave gambhīro hoti gambhīrobhāso,
an4.104:5.5: seyyathāpi so bhikkhave udakarahado gambhīro gambhīrobhāso,
an4.104:5.7: Ime cattāro udakarahadūpamā puggalā santo saṃvijjamānā lokasmin ti. 106. 1.
